title: Hausdorff measure on the span of an orthonormal n-frame is the push-forward of Lebesgue measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P (Euclid P). Put ι : ℝ^n → ℝ^P, ι(s) := Σ_i s_i τ_i (s_i the coordinates of s ∈ ℝ^n = Euclid n), and Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n}. Then the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure H^n = μHE[n] restricted to Q is the push-forward of Lebesgue measure L^n (volume on ℝ^n) under ι: H^n⌞Q = ι_#(L^n), i.e. μHE[n].restrict Q = Measure.map ι volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) = Measure.map (fun s : Euclid n => ∑ i, s i • τ i) volume
